name: Tekoa
title: Son of Ashhur in the lineage of Judah
summary: Tekoa was a son of Ashhur in the genealogy of Judah, and namesake of the town of Tekoa from which the prophet Amos came.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Tekoa is listed among the descendants of Ashhur in the tribe of Judah.
